3b221c869b.q: What does Siemens Healthineers Specialty Lab Solutions business do and how are its tests used clinically?
3b221c869b.a: Specialty Lab Solutions at Siemens Healthineers produces products used to test blood and urine samples in clinical laboratories. These tests are used to diagnose blood diseases, blood clotting disorders, allergies, and therapeutic drug levels, as well as detect illegal drugs. Ultimately, these tests help doctors make decisions about patient diagnosis and therapy.

7522b6ccf2.q: What is reverse mentoring and how does Martin Führer implement it at Siemens Healthineers?
7522b6ccf2.a: Reverse mentoring pairs a more seasoned executive with an early-career, younger talent in the organization. Führer started this experiment about two years ago with his head of HR. The reverse mentor should not report directly to the executive, confidentiality must be protected, and in-person meetings are critical for building genuine connection and trust before honest feedback can be shared.
